query: Hey, I was just out walking my golden retriever this morning and he managed to chase a squirrel all the way up a neighbor's oak tree, I had to stand there for 20 minutes coaxing him down before I could head home. Then when I got back, I tried to bake the lemon blueberry muffins I got the recipe for off social media last week, but I accidentally swapped the sugar and salt, so they turned out completely inedible and I had to throw the whole batch out. Oh, and my favorite houseplant that I've had for three years just started sprouting new leaves yesterday, I'm so excited it's finally thriving after I almost killed it by overwatering it last winter. Anyway, I need to get a couple order issues sorted out: first, for my delivered order #W4689314, I want to exchange item 5996159312 for item 8363011723, use credit_card_8105988 for any relevant payments for this exchange. Then for delivered order #W3916020, please exchange items 7758198585 and 4068787148 for items 5606522780 and 6245746168 respectively, also use credit_card_8105988 for this exchange. Lastly, cancel my pending order #W8855135, the reason is I no longer need the items.
